name: Carmel (United States)
description: Blue field with a white rising diagonal band bearing the name CARMEL in blue, a large yellow star above the date 1837 in the upper hoist, and the city seal below the date 1976 in the lower fly.
history: Carmel is a suburban city in Hamilton County, Indiana, immediately north of Indianapolis. The flag was adopted in 1976 (designed in 1976 by the former clerk-treasurer Peggy Lou Smith, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: rising diagonal band bearing the name CARMEL
city seal in yellow with the date 1976
